hypothesis: The pipeline's PC bookkeeping is off by one instruction: the IF/ID (and consequently ID/EX, EX/MEM, MEM/WB) pipeline registers capture the incremented next-PC (pc+4) as the instruction's PC instead of the PC of the word actually fetched, while the fetch data path itself is now correct (same-cycle imem_rdata consumption). Two coupled symptoms follow. (1) Every retirement reports the pair (program[pc+4], insn@pc), so the teacher TB's comparison 'retire PC/instruction does not match the loaded program' fires on essentially every retire — matching the long tail of identical t13_dft mismatch lines. (2) Because the same wrong base flows into EX, every PC-relative operation (branch target = pc+imm, JAL/JALR link = pc+4 of the wrong pc, AUIPC = pc+imm) and every comparison of the carried prediction (id_ex_pred_next_pc vs the resolved next PC) is offset by 4 bytes; the front-end therefore keeps redirecting to off-by-4 targets, the program stream diverges from the loaded image, the real ECALL word is never decoded/committed at the right PC, halted never asserts, and the TB burns the full 20 s budget — the single scored failure simulation_timeout. This is a distinct root cause from the earlier imem/dmem request-hold, stall/deadlock and BP-update-plumbing framings: the fetch handshake and the memory holds are no longer the issue; the defect is that the PC carried alongside an instruction is not that instruction's own PC.
constraints: Do not modify the teacher TB, the spec, or scoring scripts; only RTL files listed may change.
Top-level port list and names of rv32i5 are frozen exactly as specified (clk, rst_n, imem_*, dmem_*, dbg_*, halted, exit_code); no port may be added, removed or renamed.

Retirement contract: dbg_retire_pc must be the PC of the instruction being retired (not pc+4, not a live/younger PC) and dbg_retire_insn must be that same instruction word; dbg_retire_valid must pulse exactly one cycle per committed instruc

PC-relative semantics must be preserved: branch target = pc + imm, JAL/JALR link = pc + 4 of the jumping instruction, AUIPC = pc + {inst[31:12],12'b0}; the prediction carried in id_ex_pred_next_pc must be compared against the resolved next
Halt semantics: only WB may set halted/exit_code, and only for a committed ECALL (word 32'h0000_0073); after halt, PC fetch and retirement must freeze.

Reset: synchronous active-low reset; every registered output including dmem_valid, imem_valid, dbg_retire_valid and halted is 0 during reset and before the first post-reset fetch edge; imem_addr=0 and imem_addr[1:0]=00 during reset and runn

Memory model is single-cycle: imem_rdata/dmem_rdata are valid in the same cycle as the address; do not add wait states or extra response registers, do not re-introduce multi-cycle handshake holds that deadlocked earlier rounds.

Icarus Verilog 12 constraints: no variable part-selects in procedural loops, no break/continue, no whole-array/slice assignment, no inside/assert/class/interface, no signal redeclaration, files under ~600 lines.
verification_targets: t13_dft: every observed retire pair satisfies dbg_retire_insn == program[dbg_retire_pc] (zero 'retire PC/instruction does not match the loaded program' lines) and the run terminates well within the 20 s budget.
simulation_timeout flips to pass: halted asserts with a valid exit_code and the TB ends before its cycle cap on all teacher tests.

Retire count equals the architectural instruction count of each test (e.g. 132 retired instructions for the 64-control-transfer main training program), with dbg_retire_valid pulsing once per committed instruction and never while halted is h

Control-flow integrity: taken branch/JAL/JALR redirects land on pc+imm / (rs1+imm)&32'hffff_fffe, and the resolved next PC of each instruction equals the prediction carried in id_ex_pred_next_pc when correct (no spurious mispredicts caused
imem_addr[1:0] == 2'b00 every cycle, imem_addr == 0 during reset, and imem_valid/dmem_valid are 0 during reset.
